title: thelypteris scalpturoides
intro: Thelypteris scalpturoides, commonly known as the Rock Fern, is a species of fern native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant to protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of the Rock Fern are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential applications of Thelypteris scalpturoides in modern medicine.
